item.title: Dua Lipa vs. Rosé Who'd You Rather?! Singers In Snapbacks
item.description: We all know singers Dua Lipa and Rosé pop off on stage, but they're also poppin' off on camera! Which singer in snapbacks got you tippin' your hat?!

item.title: Quadruple Amputee Cornhole Pro Accused of Murder Fires Gun in Resurfaced Video, Watch
item.description: Dayton James Webber -- the professional cornhole player who happens to be a quadruple amputee now accused of murder -- showed people on social media how he can load and fire a handgun in a resurfaced clip.

item.title: Jay-Z Reveals He Was Angry, Heartbroken by Rape Allegations in Dismissed Lawsuit
item.description: Jay-Z reveals he had a really rough 2025 when now-dropped sexual assault allegations took him to a very dark place ... according to a new interview.

item.title: 'Reacher' Star Alan Ritchson Body Cam Footage of Bloody Fight With Neighbor
item.description: Alan Ritchson was armed with a body cam Sunday when he got into a quien es más macho fighting match with his very angry neighbor ... and it shows the blow-by-blow in a pretty spectacular way.

item.title: 'Married at First Sight UK' Host Mel Schilling Dead at 54
item.description: Mel Schilling -- the host of "Married at First Sight UK" -- has died.

item.title: New Found Glory's Chad Gilbert Recovering After Brain Tumors Removed
item.description: New Found Glory guitarist and singer Chad Gilbert is back on the mend after doctors found three tumors in his brain.

item.title: Robert Irwin Seen Chatting, Laughing With Wildlife Photographer Ashleigh Scully
item.description: Robert Irwin's back Down Under to shoot a new TV show ... but, it seems he brought something back to Australia with him -- a woman some online think is his perfect match.

item.title: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Says He's 'In Too Deep' Now to Stop Working Out in Jeans
item.description: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. says every time he tries to leave his working-out-in-jeans routine in the past, they keep pulling him back in ... because he feels he's in too deep to change it up now.

item.title: Alix Earle Secret 'wtfisalixdoing' Project Revealed
item.description: Alix Earle has been laying out puzzle pieces -- literally -- as to what her new brand is going to be after launching a mysterious account called "wtfisalixdoing" on social media ... and what she's doing is releasing a skincare line called Reale Actives, TMZ has learned.
